reviews.t: You will not regret buying this drill kit!
reviews.x: The odds of you finding a better nail drill at this price point are extremely low. This. Kit. Works. I do not shy away from complaining about a bad product, but that is not what I got here. As soon as I opened the drill kit, I plugged it in and I literally felt like I was using a professional kit. This kit is better than the kits some salons use.  While using, I had to lighten up on the pressure as my old kit was weak and this one is definitely not! The drill has a long cord, forward and reverse
Easy to use. Started doing my own nails since COVID, and this makes things faster and easier.

Using this nail drill was the easiest pedicure I've ever done.  I just kept it on low and was able to do a perfect, no fuss pedicure.  I was looking for something to use that would make pedicures simple since most nail salons closed - Well this is it.
Great product, excellent condition. Fast shipping. Would definitely recommend.
It's light weight. It came fast. It will be great to do my own nails.
Works great so far. Easy to use and light weight

reviews.t: Solid e-file with everything you need!
reviews.x: Honestly, an e-file is not something I really need to use for my own nails, but it is something my mom constantly talks about getting to use to remove when she occasionally gets gel or dip or some other kind of manicure which she doesn't have the patience to remove without severely damaging her nails, even when I try to help... So I got this to use on her, and I'm very happy with it! It feels solid, and is comfortable to use even for long periods of time. I used it to remove my mom's dip nails y

All it seemed to do is give me some nasty scratches in some delicate places! Sure it comes with a pile of attachments, but they're all awful!!  Seriously tho... It's a decent nail drill, and I dig the adjustable speed on it. It's delicate enough for use on nails and other projects that require precision over power. And the array of bits you get really is great! But why it not rechargeable? So I gotta keep it plugged into a usb port the whole time I use it? The cord that comes with it is just und

Pros: It's gentle- when I slip and touch my skin, it doesn't hurt. It's effective- the various bits included provide accurate removal of cuticles and dead skin, smoothing of nail surface to prep for polish, and quick shaping without much effort. It's got a good quality feel to it, easy to hold and work with, and I have small hands. It's much faster, more accurate and easier than trying to accomplish the same things with a file. Changing the bits is simple- pull one out, push one in! It comes wit

This nail drill appears to be nice but ... totally stopped working after jus 10 seconds...  idk why.. i followed all instructions. I Live in the Bahamas  so.. i cant get a refund ..!! Because I cant return it free...  Can the person selling these help me..?? I dont know.  But.... DONT BUY IF YOU CANT RETURN EASILY ..!!

It works really well you can choose how fast or slow it goes. It also gives you a left or right option as far as the direction of the file. It plugs into any cell phone charger port which is AWESOME for it being portable. Came with bits, nail dust brush, nail drill, extra file attachments...

reviews.t: It's easy and gets the job done
reviews.x: I've had this a little over a month. Have used it a few times, itsgrwat for pedicures too!! However I'm very VERY disappointed cause it stopped working, outta nowhere, thats why I rated it only 2 stars....if it was still working it would've been 5 stars

Works great and very easy to use! A great kit for people just starting out with nails. I also use it for various other things that I need to sand down a bit around the house, it works great on multiple things! Definitely recommend!

To be honest, I wasn’t expecting much with the price, but I took a chance and I don’t regret it. I’m just using it at home but I’m definitely happy with the purchase. It works great, seems sturdy and comes with a lifetime warranty.

reviews.t: Great for a beginner nail drill.
reviews.x: I brought this nail drill for school and I have absolutely been loving it. It's obviously super affordable and convenient! It's came at the perfect time too, thank you I love my nail drill and I feel it was a great investment 😊

reviews.t: Very durable and easy to use 💅
reviews.x: This electric nail drill/file is very durable and easy to use. I only wish the cord was a little longer. The drawstring bag (included) makes it easy to store. Overall, I'm very pleased with this kit and I recommend it.

reviews.t: Cheap crap dies a lot even when plugged in the wall
reviews.x: I've had this drill for a couple months now and loved the way it worked, recently though the drill starting turning off on its own in the middle of working on my client's nails....not happy
I love this nail drill. It's so much more than I expected. Not like the kind you get from family dollar. This is light weight, very easy to use. Makes me feel like I'm a pro. Lol

reviews.t: Nice but is it bran new?
reviews.x: I liked the look and feel of the drill. The drill bits seem a little full and the package for them had stuff all over it like it could have possibly been used before.
Only used it once, halfway through use it just turned off and won’t turn back on. Would return but I don’t have any of the packaging anymore. Super disappointed.
This tool is for a child it breaks easily. Over heats quickly and is only ment for natural nails. Do not use longer then a hr or is will stop working
Not happy and there is no way to contact the seller. 2 of the drill bits do not fit  at all, so you can't use them. Super angry about this.
Not happy and there is no way to contact the seller. 2 of the drill bits do not fit  at all, so you can't use them. Super angry about this.

reviews.t: Slim and lighter than I thought
reviews.x: This drill is the best. It’s slimmer than I thought it would be and portable which makes it easier to use anywhere.
Used it once and stopped working. Won’t turn on anymore no matter how long I have it plugged in. Waste of money.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the drill as easy to use and great for beginners or at-home use.
Many praise it as a great value for the price, often exceeding expectations.
Several reviewers report the drill stopped working after a short time.
Reviewers appreciate the included attachments and bits, calling it a complete kit.
Some note it is lightweight and portable, including plugging into a phone charger port.
